final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), first_cut AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN first_average a WHERE r.avg_length > a.avg_length), first_cut_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM first_cut) SELECT AVG(f.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_length, AVG(f.avg_length - a.avg_length) AS mean_above_overall_average, AVG(f.avg_length - c.avg_length) AS mean_above_first_cut_average FROM first_cut f CROSS JOIN first_average a CROSS JOIN first_cut_average c WHERE f.avg_length > c.avg_length
